routes.independence: route B contains no executable import of route A; the test parses route B's AST and asserts it. Route A searches the program space by walking bit strings of each length in increasing integer order and decoding each one, computes Shannon entropy by closed-form exponent algebra, takes the microstate count from the registered support tuple, and derives erased bits from the forward image. Route B enumerates instruction sequences depth-first in instruction-table order with no decoder at all, computes Shannon entropy by building the canonical code tree and accumulating integer leaf depths over a common power-of-two denominator, builds the microstate set explicitly, derives erased bits by partitioning the domain into preimage classes, and represents register states as integers under bitwise operations rather than as strings.

rows_left_open.row: - [ ] Measure actual energy on real hardware for selected GMI morphology transitions.
rows_left_open.instrument_required: calibrated hardware power measurement: a wall-plug or on-die power meter (for example a Yokogawa WT series power analyser, or NVIDIA NVML / Intel RAPL energy counters cross-calibrated against it) attached to a named device running the named architecture transition, with a registered physical system (boundary, dynamics, reservoir, temperature) and a stated measurement uncertainty. This package registers 0 physical systems and computes no energy value, so it cannot and does not close this row.

rows_left_open.row: - [ ] Test whether information-theoretic savings predict physical energy savings; preserve negative results if hardware overhead dominates.
rows_left_open.instrument_required: a matched information-savings/energy-savings experiment on that same calibrated instrument: two implementations whose information-theoretic saving is measured and whose joule cost is measured on identical hardware under identical thermal conditions, with the negative result preserved if hardware overhead dominates. The exact non-inference witness in this package (same erased-bit count, registered operation counts 2 versus 7) is the formal reason such an experiment is REQUIRED; it is not a substitute for it.

rows_left_open.row: - [ ] For biological claims, separate energetic maintenance of life from cognitive information processing.
rows_left_open.instrument_required: a biological metabolic measurement separating maintenance from information processing: indirect calorimetry or a stable-isotope (doubly labelled water) protocol on a named organism or tissue, paired with a neural-activity measurement, so that basal metabolic upkeep and the energetic cost of information processing are attributed separately.
